items.title: REPEATED same-window (after-hours -> after-hours) snapshot on the frozen 07-31 bar returns BYTE-IDENTICAL Tier-A values - the previously-monotonically-drifting off-hours legs (BTC-USD, global-rotation EWS/FX) now settle FLAT, so this run advances the snapshot clock (20:30:23.326Z -> 22:08:43.166Z) without advancing the window label, the completed-bar frontier, coverage split, or any persistence counter.
items.note: Genuinely new vs the prior 'off-hours monotonic drift + FX-label crossing' pattern (which fired when the lone crypto leg firmed a second window and EWS crossed an FX-strength label). Three facts distinguish this run: (1) DRIFT SETTLES TO ZERO: the BTC-USD daily-dated leg holds 31.6 (prior after-hours window value) on its unchanged 2026-08-02T00:00:00.000Z stamp and Downtrend classification (mom21 -0.66, mom63 -13.92, mom126 -3.97) - after the sequence 31.4 -> 31.1 -> 30.9 -> 31.3 -> 31.6 it now posts a SIXTH same-07-31-bar reading with NO change, i.e. the off-hours re-quote converged. (2) THE FX-LABEL CROSSING DOES NOT RE-CROSS: the carried global-rotation leader EWS stays at 84.3 with fxStrength +0.66 and fx 'Confirms leadership' (asOf 2026-07-31T13:30:00.000Z) - the neutral -> 'Confirms leadership' boundary crossed in the prior window is held, not re-crossed, and EWU/EWA/EWC/EWG (71.7/67.0/66.7/61.8) are all unchanged. (3) STRUCTURE STAYS BYTE-FROZEN FOR A FIFTH SNAPSHOT: VIX 15.99 (band 'VIX 16.0', score 0), SPY 747.03 (ma50Dist +0.38%, ma200Dist +7.12%, -1.4% from the 52w high, mom126 +8.21%, mom252 +19.05%), the sector RRG (XLY into quad I accel +0.9, XLE out quad L, XLV leader quad W), the gamma/structure levels (flip 740.09, walls 741/749, EM ±4.27, signedNetGEX +2.199B), heatmap breadth 48.64% narrow, and the volatility-sizing forecast 13.9101% throttle ×1.08 are all unchanged. Signature: a same-window re-run (window label unchanged, snapshot asOf advanced) on an unadvanced completed bar can produce a ZERO-drift re-quote in which even the legs that drifted in prior windows are now flat - and this still must never move persistence.
items.method: Extend the 'off-hours monotonic drift + qualitative-state-crossing' detector with a 'same-window zero-drift re-quote' test that fires when a NEWER snapshot advances the snapshot asOf WITHOUT changing the window label AND WITHOUT advancing the completed-bar frontier AND every off-hours-dated leg is UNCHANGED versus the prior window. Trigger on SIX tests: (1) SNAPSHOT ADVANCES BUT WINDOW LABEL DOES NOT = snapshot.asOf increases (2026-08-02T20:30:23.326Z -> 2026-08-02T22:08:43.166Z) while snapshot.window is unchanged (after-hours -> after-hours); (2) BAR FRONTIER UNCHANGED = dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate still 2026-07-31 with freshSymbolCount == symbolCount and carriedSymbolCount == 0 and missingSymbolCount == 0 (287/287, 0, 0) - a same-bar re-price, NOT an append; (3) COVERAGE HELD FLAT = richCount/coverageCount unchanged (12/10) and no tool flips STALE<->ANALYZED versus the prior window; (4) STRUCTURAL LEVELS UNCHANGED = regime + bench byte-identical (VIX 15.99 / band 'VIX 16.0' / score 0; SPY 747.03 / +0.38% / +7.12% / +8.21% / +19.05%) and the sector RRG metrics identical (XLY into, XLE out, XLV leader); (5) OFF-HOURS ZERO-DRIFT = each off-hours-dated leg is unchanged vs the prior window (BTC-USD 31.6 -> 31.6 on its unchanged 08-02 stamp; global-rotation EWS 84.3 -> 84.3, fx 'Confirms leadership' -> 'Confirms leadership'); (6) PERSISTENCE MUST NOT INCREMENT = because no NEW distinct completed bar date exists, an identical read keeps its prior distinct-bar count (XLY stays early-persistent across [07-30, 07-31] = 2; the structural tools stay at 1 = [07-31]). HARD RULE: count persistence by DISTINCT completed market-bar dates only - a same-window re-run (after-hours -> after-hours) on the SAME 07-31 bar does NOT increment the counter, whether an off-hours-dated leg drifts (as in the prior window) or holds flat (as in this window).

bars.note: The completed 07-31 daily session was appended in the pre-market window; every window since (morning, pre-close, and now two after-hours snapshots) re-prices the SAME 07-31 bar without advancing the frontier (287/287 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing).
